_doc: Spain's train stations for Getting around, written by onboarding-site/src/stations.py from Renfe's two open timetable files (suburban; high speed, long and middle distance), run by hand when Renfe renews them (not by build.py). Credit: "Origen de los datos: Renfe Operadora", with the date (source.updated), licence CC BY 4.0. source.day: the Tuesday the trains were counted on. cities: [{id, ids (Renfe station ids), name, i18n (the name in a language where it differs), lat, lng, main (a house's city is chosen among these)}]. stations (at least 4 trains that day): [{id (Renfe's), name (as Renfe writes it), lat, lng, lines: [{t, c, ink}] (a guide's badges: suburban lines in the file's colours, then long distance services in the colours of engine/src/modules/transport/brands.json; each with 3 or more trains a day), hs (true: 4 or more high speed trains a day), to: [{id (a city), n (direct trains that day, for the picking rule only, never shown), min (the 4th fastest direct journey in minutes, the slowest with fewer than 4)}] (cities with 3 or more direct trains)}]. Which stations a house gets: engine/src/modules/transport/pick.js. Rules: engine/src/modules/transport/README.md.
